g.text: Stillday: deployment, observability and capacity control
API: 0.25 vCPU / 0.5 GiB. Worker: 1 vCPU / 2 GiB. Shared course IAM roles.
Worker logs also go to CloudWatch. Log expiry is not enabled under current course permissions.
